title: Fallback contract validation and route-insight telemetry
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: As smart routing increasingly uses region selection, tiered routing, and automated fallback to model variants, we lack a compact, actionable way to validate that fallback behavior adhered to declared contracts (latency/cost/quality) and to correlate fallback events with downstream user-visible regressions. This ticket defines a set of telemetry artifacts and a validation pass that will: 1) emit a compact fallback contract record whenever a routing policy elects a fallback variant, 2) attach per-hop micrometrics that make it possible to attribute latency/cost regressions to route stages (selector, router, model proxy, variant), and 3) provide a lightweight replay slice for on-call and postmortem analysis without shipping full payloads. Goal: improve triage time for routing-induced regressions and enable automated alerting when fallback behavior violates negotiated contract thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A new structured 'fallback_contract' telemetry record is emitted whenever a routing policy routes to a fallback model variant with fields: policy_id, candidate_variant, contract_thresholds(latency_ms, cost_units, quality_score), observed_values(latency_ms, cost_units, quality_score), reason_code.

Per-hop micrometrics are recorded for selector -> router -> proxy -> model and include: hop_latency_ms, queue_depth, batch_size, cache_hit (boolean), and variant_id. These are queryable in Console for any request span.

A compressed 'replay_slice' artifact (policy input, selected variant metadata, 3 sampled KV cache frames, and aggregated per-hop metrics) is persisted for sampled fallbacks for 30 days and can be downloaded from Console.
Console has a new 'Fallback Insights' dashboard showing fallback rate by policy, median time-to-fallback, top reason codes, and 95th percentile per-hop latency for fallback paths.
Automated rule: raise an alert when fallback_rate for a policy > 1% and median fallback latency exceeds contract latency by > 20% for 10m window.
E2E tests that simulate a tier outage and assert telemetry records are emitted and replay_slice contains expected fields.
Telemetry schema and client changes are backwards compatible (old consumers can ignore new fields).
implementation_plan: 1) Schema: define fallback_contract and per-hop micrometric schema (telemetry-infra owners + runtime).
2) Runtime changes: instrument route decision point to emit fallback_contract record and attach per-hop metrics as spans; add sampling hooks for replay_slice creation.
3) Storage: extend telemetry writer to accept compressed replay_slice blobs and index by policy_id + request_date.
4) Console: new dashboard tile and download action for replay_slice (UX by Design).
5) Tests: unit, integration and a small-scale chaos test that triggers fallback paths.
6) Rollout: progressive enable via feature flag scoped by org for two weeks, then global rollout if metrics stable.
changes: Add telemetry type: fallback_contract {policy_id, request_id, chosen_variant, contract_thresholds, observed_values, reason_code, timestamp}
Attach per-hop tags to existing decision spans: hop_name, hop_latency_ms, queue_depth, batch_size, cache_hit, variant_id
Implement replay_slice creation pipeline: sample N fallbacks per minute per policy, compress JSON, store in telemetry blobstore
Expose replay_slice download endpoint behind Console permission 'telemetry:download_replay'
Add indexing for policy_id and reason_code in telemetry index to support fast queries
rollout_plan: Feature flag default: disabled. Stage 1: enable for internal orgs + 3 beta customers for 48h.
Stage 2: enable for 25% of orgs (random) for 7 days, monitor fallback_rate, index performance, and blobstore size.
Stage 3: enable for all orgs with opt-out for Dedicated instances if requested by account.
If alert triggers (telemetry writer errors or index latencies > SLO): rollback flag and fail open to existing behavior (no fallback_contract emission).
QA_steps: Unit tests for schema changes and writer behavior.
Integration test that simulates fallback due to model OOM and verifies fallback_contract and per-hop metrics presence.
Chaos test: induce region tier latency spike; assert sampled replay_slice includes expected selector input and chosen_variant metadata.
Manual QA: use Console to query a beta org and download replay_slice; verify compressed artifact decompresses and matches schema.
Load test: verify telemetry index write throughput with 500 req/s generating 0.5% fallbacks.
